content.title: Christmas Tree Recycling
content.summary: Arvada residents can recycle their Christmas trees for free at Stenger Sports Complex from December 26, 2025, to January 19, 2026, daily from 6:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Trees must be free of decorations, nails, and wire, and the city does not accept garlands, wreaths, or yard waste. Free mulch will be available at the drop-off site, but residents must load and transport it themselves.
content.body:
![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2662)Each year the City offers free Christmas tree recycling for Arvada residents at Stenger Sports Complex.

The drop-off site is located at the at the southwest corner of the W 58th Ave. and Oak St. intersection (view map below).

   

Mulch is made available free of charge at the drop-off site location during the collection period. Residents are responsible for loading and hauling their own mulch.

## Christmas tree recycling dates

- Dec. 26, 2025 through Jan. 19, 2026
- Times: 6:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., seven days a week

## Guidelines for Christmas tree recycling

- Please make sure the tree is free of nails, wire and all decorations to ensure safety of City staff handling the trees.
- We do not accept garlands, wreaths, or yard waste.
- Business or commercial use not permitted.
